name: pr-task-link-guard
description: Refuses gh pr create unless the PR body links a task on your task board.

task_link_pattern.title: Task link pattern
task_link_pattern.description: JavaScript regex, matched case-insensitively, that a task link in the PR body must match. Example: linear\.app/[^/]+/issue/. Empty turns the check off.

repo_scope.title: Repo scope
repo_scope.description: Regex on the owner/repo slug. Only matching repos are checked. Empty checks every repo.
